Join a modern warehouse where logistics meets innovation. You will become part of an international team working for well-known global brands in a fast-paced and organised environment. What do you need to qualify for the Warehouse Operative position? You are available to work at least 32 hours per week and you are flexible and available to work from Monday through Sunday You are able to work in a two-shift rotation You have English language skills at a minimum A2 level You have your own accommodation/housing You live in or near Echt and have your own transportation to travel to the workplace; the company is not accessible by public transport. Think you're the right fit? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now! Wat bieden wij je? You will be joining an innovative and supportive work environment where many employees progress into new roles. Personal development is encouraged, and there are genuine career opportunities alongside an attractive benefits package. As a Warehouse Operative / Order Picker, you can expect: Competitive hourly salary up to €15.27 per hour, depending on experience, plus shift allowances. 25 vacation days + 8% holiday allowance Work clothes and safety shoes provided A long-term position with the opportunity to secure a permanent contract A little extra cheer on your birthday: we surprise you with a small gift to celebrate your special day. Opportunities to grow into positions such as Quality Control or Team Lead Functieomschrijving As a Warehouse Operative, you are responsible for handling and processing goods within the warehouse. You ensure that orders are accurately picked, checked, packed, and shipped. Depending on operational requirements, you will be assigned to the department where your support is needed most. Your responsibilities as a Warehouse Operative / Order Picker include: Picking products at the pick line Checking and packng orders Scanning items and processing returns Labeling shipments for specific customers or countries You will

work a minimum of 4 days per week, from Monday to Sunday, in a two-shift rotation: Between 06:00 - 00:00 During peak periods, you may also be scheduled to work on weekends. This position offers opportunities for career growth into roles such as Quality Controller or Team Leader for employees who demonstrate initiative, commitment, and strong performance. Where will you work? At the Heijen location, logistics is about much more than simply moving boxes. This modern, high-tech warehouse manages daily operations for well-known brands, delivering smart and efficient supply chain solutions. You will work in an innovative environment equipped with advanced technologies that ensure accurate, efficient, and streamlined processes. This is a place where you will have the opportunity to develop your skills and grow within an international, team-oriented organization. Ready to get started? Apply today and launch your career in a modern and innovative logistics environment.

- Venlo - 40 uur - € 18,28 per uur 
Would you like to work in a logistics job with a lot of variety and nice working hours? Are you physically fit and do you like hard work? Then this is the job for you in Venlo! 
What do we offer? - Starting gross hourly wage of €18,28; - Full-time job in day shift from 07:00 - 16:00; - Prospect of permanent employment with good performance; - Great working atmosphere within a close-knit team of around 10 colleagues; - Varied work: no two days are the same; - Working for a stable organisation with international roots.
